constraints: Keep the resource's behavior unchanged: the same name, namespace, labels, and spec semantics.

The replacement (apps/v1 DaemonSet, available since v1.9) can differ in required fields or field names from the removed version; read the DaemonSet entry in the Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide and convert the manifest accordingly.

steps.instructions: Change the reported `apiVersion` to the replacement version (apps/v1 DaemonSet, available since v1.9).
steps.title: Change the DaemonSet apiVersion

steps.instructions: Apply the field changes the migration guide lists for DaemonSet, then check the manifest still expresses the same intent.
steps.title: Convert fields the new version changed

steps.instructions: Update every other manifest, Helm template, and kustomize patch or target that names the old DaemonSet API version, so the repository agrees.
steps.title: Align other DaemonSet declarations

verification.purpose: Validate the migrated manifests against the schemas of the target Kubernetes version.
Ask a cluster on the target version to accept the migrated manifest without applying it.
For a Helm chart, render it and validate the output.

sources.title: Kubernetes 1.16: Custom Resources, Overhauled Metrics, and Volume Extensions (release announcement, 2019-09-18)

rule.summary: The Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide states that the extensions/v1beta1 API version of DaemonSet is no longer served as of v1.16, which was released on 2019-09-18.
rule.title: DaemonSet extensions/v1beta1 is no longer served
